facts.text: Audrey donates a portion of her jewelry profits to an animal shelter.

evidence.quote: I donate to an animal shelter. They do great work, so it's my way of helping out.
I donate a portion of my profits to a cause that's close to my heart.

facts.text: Audrey creates jewelry from recycled materials as a hobby and for sale.

evidence.quote: I love making jewelry out of recycled stuff. It's a great way to show my love of creativity and sustainability.
Do you make jewelry to sell or just as a hobby?
I started making jewelry as a hobby and then started selling it.

facts.text: Audrey's jewelry is made from items like bottle caps, buttons, and broken jewelry.

evidence.quote: I hunt down things like bottle caps, buttons, and broken jewelry, and then turn them into one-of-a-kind pieces.

facts.text: Audrey believes that any hobby can have an impact when used right.

evidence.quote: Any hobby can have an impact when used right - I donate to an animal shelter.
